name: Offline place search (geocode) and reverse geocode on a local places file
description: Find places by name in a local places dataset with Turkish-aware fuzzy matching (Jaro-Winkler; İ/ı, ş, ğ, ç, ö, ü folded), optionally filtered by category and ranked by distance to a reference point; or reverse geocode a coordinate to the nearest named street, nearest named area (mahalle/quarter) and nearby places. Answers "Moda Eczanesi nerede?" and "bu nokta hangi sokakta?".

provenance.metadata_source: public GitHub repository API (license field and created_at), observed this round; actual license file inspected
provenance.reference_values: Fixture places are synthetic (CC0). Expected matches, scores, counts and reverse results were produced by reference/upstream_harness.py: an independent re-implementation of the documented ranking that calls the pinned upstream jellyfish pure-Python jaro_winkler_similarity and Skillpack's shared file loader, without importing the port. jellyfish fixtures themselves are covered by pack M023.

dataset.description: Dataset name (no folders), e.g. demo_kadikoy or my_pois.csv

budget.enforcement: Raw CLI byte limit and POSIX alarm; strict schema, finite values and nesting checks; MCP subprocess killed/reaped after 10 seconds. One active calculation. Not a hostile-code sandbox.

data.reads: local files by dataset name from SKILLPACK_MAP_DATA or ../map_data

mcp.instructions: Local offline map tool. The dataset is a file NAME inside the folder the user configured (SKILLPACK_MAP_DATA); never invent coordinates or names. Results come from the local data and code; explain them, state data limits (no live traffic) and ask the human to confirm before acting on them. Credit OpenStreetMap contributors when showing OSM-derived data.

limitations: Name lookup in the local file only: no house-number interpolation, no postal addresses, no spelling suggestions beyond Jaro-Winkler similarity, and no ranking by popularity. Several places can share a name (chains, stops); always show the candidates with category and coordinates and let the human pick. Score = max(JW(query, name), 0.95 x best JW over name word windows of the query length) after Turkish folding; default threshold 0.85. Reverse geocoding returns the nearest representative point of a named street and the nearest named place point (quarter, neighbourhood, square ...), not a containing polygon, within max_distance_m (default 500). Category words may be Turkish or English (eczane -> pharmacy).
port_notes: Jaro-Winkler is the M023 port of jellyfish _jellyfish.py _jaro_winkler (winklerize on, long_tolerance off), unchanged. Distances use the haversine formula in the same operation order as geodesy latlon-spherical distanceTo (R = 6371 km). Normalisation, word-window scoring, category aliases and tie-breaking (score, distance to near point, file order) are Skillpack rules documented here.
